fato_historico: 1692: The Salem witch trials are ended by a letter from Province of Massachusetts Bay Governor William Phips.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a gentle shift in the air, much like the clearing of old mist after a long, difficult storm. It is a good time to release past burdens and embrace emotional clarity. Allow your intuitive heart to guide you, as the tides turn toward peace and fresh beginnings in your personal life.
frase_do_dia: Clear the shadows of yesterday to let your true spirit shine brightly today.
significado_numero: Represents completion and the harmonious cycle of ending old chapters peacefully.
conselho: Consider letting go of outdated worries to create space for your new luck.
